hypothesis: The rejected Space catalyst static pool may become a useful specialist alpha direction if its high-volatility entries are carried at a small sleeve-level risk budget rather than full core size.
interpretation: Risk scalar alone does not turn the static Space pool into acceptable alpha. Continue only with event-dated forward replacement value or a non-hindsight official-catalyst discriminator.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: The Space event-state ledger has only one mature outcome; this run tests risk allocation instead of fabricating soft-ranking labels.

next_evidence_needed: Do not enable live/default Space trades from static-pool scalar evidence.
Collect forward official-catalyst Space decisions with direct, same-theme, UFO/ARKX-relative, and core replacement value.
If forward evidence passes, implement a shared default-off pilot adapter with explicit small risk budget and parity tests.

protocol_answers.4_gate: Use docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows. Accept observed-only direction only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, all three windows improve EV, max drawdown damage <= 2 pp, survival >= 5%, and concentration guard holds.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Rerun this script from repo root; it writes compact JSON/MD artifacts and does not mutate shared strategy modules.

rejection_reason: No tested Space static-pool risk scalar passed the three-window gate with positive aggregate EV/PnL, all-window EV improvement, drawdown damage <= 2 pp, survival >= 5%, and concentration within guard.
